summary: Studio City Finance Limited, a subsidiary of Studio City International Holdings Ltd, filed a Form 6-K announcing a partial redemption of US$165,000,000 of its US$500,000,000 6.500% Senior Notes due 2028. The redemption price is 100.000% of principal plus accrued interest to the Redemption Date of July 18, 2026. This is a standard debt reduction transaction, returning capital to noteholders. The filing includes a notice of partial redemption under the indenture dated July 15, 2020, with Deutsche Bank Trust Company Americas as trustee. Watch for the impact on Studio City's leverage profile and any subsequent redemptions or refinancing plans.
